Name: jacs' Portraits
Author: jacs
TagLine: HiRes portrait replacements for Pelican Town's 12 Bachelor/ettes
Description:
### Hi Res portrait replacements for Pelican Town's 12 Bachelor/ettes!

I made this mod to challenge and improve my drawing skills!  I would love to draw portraits for all the characters but for now I'd like to move on to other projects.
This is my first mod and idk what I'm doing so please let me know if you find any issues!

**Installation:** Extract/unzip the file version you want into your Mods folder with the other required mods installed!
**This mod requires the following:**
* [SMAPI](https://smapi.io/) [Nexus](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400)
* Content Patcher [ModDrop](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/470174-content-patcher) [Nexus](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915)
and either
* HD Portraits [ModDrop](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/1103418-hd-portraits) [Nexus](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971)
* AeroCore [ModDrop](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/1275014-aerocore) [Nexus](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14700) HD Portraits has been updated to require AeroCore!!
or 
* PyTK - Platonymous Toolkit [ModDrop](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/793815-pytk-platonymous-toolkit) [Nexus](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726)
**Please make sure you download the correct version; I have two available depending on which portrait loader you want to use.**


Special thanks to [Data_](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9277) who put together the PyTK version for me, Wren (HD Portraits), the folks in the SDV discord, and everyone that's been following my progress and cheering me on!


Have fun! ＼(￣▽￣)／ 
-jacs
